text: Coffee with Valentina. Her dad passed away last Tuesday and the funeral is on November 4. She seemed numb more than anything. Her brother is flying in from Canada and she's sorting most of it herself because her mum can't face it. She asked if I'd do a reading. I said yes, obviously, but I've never done one before.
Jada and Florin are hosting a housewarming sometime next week. I'm bringing the dessert.

Noah got made redundant from the logistics firm on Friday. He's putting a brave face on it but I think he's pretty shaken. His wife Ciara is pregnant with their second, due in early March, which makes the timing awful. He's going to try contracting for a while. Remind me to call him early next week and send him that recruiter's details.
Hannah is flying to Tokyo on March 3rd for two weeks. Her first long-haul flight on her own and she's slightly terrified.
Don't forget to ask Jack how the job hunt is going.
Abebe loves Ethiopian jazz, especially Mulatu Astatke. Worth remembering for his birthday on 7/22.
Julia and Oliver broke up. Apparently it happened over the summer and she only told people now. She's doing fine, she says, and has thrown herself into bouldering.
Need to buy a card and some flowers for Vera before her mum's funeral on Thursday.

Imogen invited us to her 40th at the end of the month. It's a garden party at her parents' place in Kent. She said absolutely no presents, but she did mention she's been wanting a decent pasta machine. Her husband Jack is organising a surprise slideshow and wants old photos by the 20th.
Ravi is off to Portugal early March with his girlfriend. They've booked a villa near Lagos.
Called Kiri. Her grandad died on October 12 and she's flying back to Auckland for the tangi. She sounded completely wrung out. I should send her a message once she lands.
Kiara's leaving drinks are on June 3rd at the Crown. She's moving to Dublin for a new job.
Dorota is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Keep in mind for the dinner party.
Book the car in for its MOT and renew the travel insurance before the end of the month.

Zainab said the engagement party on May 14 has been called off. She and Tariq split up a couple of weeks ago. She's heartbroken. She kept apologising for the hassle, which broke my heart. Her parents had already paid the deposit on the venue. I want to take her out for lunch sometime next week, just the two of us, and maybe suggest a weekend away later in the spring.
Björn's back from his trip to Iceland. Must ask him for the photos of the glacier walk.
Alana and Kalani are celebrating their tenth anniversary in Maui over the summer. Kalani's mum is coming along to babysit the kids.

Tamar told me her company is making cuts and she has a redundancy meeting on Monday at 10. She's worried sick. Remind me to text her good luck on Sunday night and then check in with her after the meeting.
Yuki's cat Mochi has to be put to sleep this week. Yuki is in bits about it.
Reggie's 60th dinner was lovely. Really need to send him the photos from the night.
Camila mentioned she's going to Colombia at Christmas to see her family for the first time in four years.
Aneesh lives in Leeds now and works for the council. His wife Priya is a teacher.
Ciara's flight to Boston got moved to 6/18, so the farewell brunch is now June 15th instead.

Long chat with Ava tonight. Her brother Sam lost his job last month when the factory closed, and now their mum is ill too, so Ava is driving up to Glasgow most weekends. She's exhausted but says it's fine. She's still planning the trip to Lisbon in early April with Caitlin, which I think she really needs. I should offer to cover her shift on the 9th so she can get away a day early.
Ivan's leaving do got cancelled because half the team is off sick. Rescheduled for sometime next week, date TBC.
Remind me to ask Aarav how his sister's wedding in Jaipur went.
Anders is obsessed with sailing and has a little boat moored at Brighton. Also allergic to shellfish.
Went for a walk with Valentina. She's doing a bit better since the funeral, though her mum is struggling. Should pop round with some food for them at the weekend.
Jada's birthday is August 9. She loves anything from that candle shop in Brighton.
Florin has a big family wedding in Bucharest on September 20th and is nervous about giving a speech in Romanian.
I'm flying to Madrid on April 2nd and back on the 8th. Need to sort a pet sitter.
Hannah Walsh from work had a miscarriage. Don't mention it to anyone. Send her a kind note.
Jack and his partner are expecting! Due sometime in early March.
Noah's dog Bruno went missing yesterday. They found him this morning two streets away, thank god. Noah is relieved.
Dinner at Oliver's on Saturday. He's doing his famous lamb. I'm in charge of wine.
Abebe's grandmother passed away in Addis two years ago. He still talks about her cooking.
Imogen said the trip to Peru is off because her knee surgery got moved to May 20. She's gutted. Remind me to send her something nice for recovery.
Kiara is a nurse at St Thomas'. Loves true crime podcasts and Crossfit.

Spoke with Mrs Nakamura next door. Her husband's funeral is on 11/2 at the church on Hill Road. Her son is flying over from Osaka on Thursday to help with everything, and her daughter arrives the day before the service. She seemed calm but kept losing her train of thought. I should go and maybe bring a casserole round the day after.
Ravi and his wife are hosting a Diwali party on November 1st and everyone's invited, kids too. Their son Arjun is turning five the same week.
Uncle Reggie is in hospital after his fall. Ring Aunt Dorota tomorrow evening to see how he is.
Tidy the spare room and wash the bedding before the end of the month.

Kalani starts a new job in Honolulu in June, so they are moving back sometime over the summer. Alana is excited but sad to leave her friends here. We need to do a proper goodbye dinner for them before they go, maybe the last weekend of May.
Julia went to the Amalfi Coast last week. Must ask her how it was.

Björn and his wife have just split after twenty years. He's taking it very hard. Text him this weekend, and maybe invite him to the barbecue on July 4th. Their daughter Ava is starting uni in September, so he's dreading the house being empty. He said he might go walking in Norway over the summer to clear his head.
Zainab's sister Amira graduates from Edinburgh on June 28th. The whole family is going.
Caitlin mentioned she has a fear of flying, so the trip to New York in late October is a big deal for her. Wish her luck before she goes.
Camila Santos at the gym has just been made redundant from the bank. She seemed upbeat though, says she's going to travel around South America for a few months over the winter.
Tamar texted. The meeting went fine and she kept her job. Over the moon.
Ivan, or Vanya as his family calls him, is moving to Prague end of the month. Get him a farewell present, he's into board games.
